response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), a AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) AS avg_cnt) SELECT c.driverId, c.cnt AS qualifying_count, c.cnt / a.avg_cnt AS ratio FROM c, a ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average over all drivers equals total qualifying rows divided by the number of rows in drivers (drivers without records count as zero). Qualifying rows whose driverId is not in drivers, if any, are still counted in the numerator.
Ties in ratio are broken arbitrarily.
